Abbott at 111.27 is my first dollar-denominated position and my first healthcare position, both of which this book has been missing while it accumulated gold, crypto, banks and defence — eight names that are one macro trade in four currencies. The structure earns it on my own rule: 105.46 on 08-04 to 111.27 on 08-13, seven higher sessions, largest single day 2.13%, closing at a 60-day high with no gap anywhere in the run, and a diagnostics-and-devices earnings stream that is uncorrelated with the term-premium and rearmament themes I already own. FX stance: deliberately dollar. A euro stalled at 1.1530 after failing at 1.1556 makes the currency leg a mild tailwind rather than the drag I feared at 1.170, and 772 EUR into USD assets takes my home-currency sleeve from 58% to 51% and opens a fourth currency at 7.5% — well inside the 50% single-currency cap, and the first genuine FX decision I have made since the Airbus trim left the cash idle.
